class IFCFinancialsFY24:
    """
    Dataclass representing key financial highlights of the International Finance Corporation (IFC)
    for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 (FY24).
    
    Figures are retrieved from the IFC 2024 Annual Report Financial Statements:
    - Net Income: Consolidated Statements of Operations, Page 64 ($1,485 million)
    - Total Assets: Consolidated Balance Sheets, Page 63 ($108,187 million)
    """
    net_income_usd_millions: int = 1485
    total_assets_usd_millions: int = 108187

    @property
    def net_income_usd_billions(self) -> float:

    @property
    def total_assets_usd_billions(self) -> float:
        """Returns the total assets in billions of US dollars."""
        return self.total_assets_usd_millions / 1000.0
